beta_explicit_port_walkie_config.owned_config: isolated CIEL_RUNTIME_CONFIG_DIR seeded from live global+walkie workspace config, outward receivers/bridges/web backends removed, CIEL_RUNTIME_ROUTER_PORT=19611

interpretation.confirmed: Default beta startup showed a blank terminal for about 29.5 s. Parent import plus its own 7.5 s scan precede the first diagnostic child at 8.9 s. Two recursive launcher --version children each pay about 1.3 s base plus their own 7.5 s scan (8.9 s to 26.2 s). Update check and menu render follow until 29.5 s. With an explicit port (no scan) the same product reached the menu at 9.1 s.
interpretation.consistent_not_proven: After the menu renders the launcher idles in read_menu_key with no child, no TCP and flat CPU, the same external signature recorded for PID408. Earlier walkie launches also show 55 s to 15 min gaps between remote sync and the next launch log line while the menu waited for input. PID408 exited before its frame could be captured.

component_measurements.closed_loopback_probe_seconds: 0.154-0.187 each (full 150 ms timeout); live routers 9487/9489 answered in 0.005-0.007
component_measurements.note: A separate exploration reported 0.79 s for an unused-loopback scan; direct measurement of the actual range on this machine contradicts it and is the value used here.
